'''Kyle Kuzma''' (born July 24, 1995) is an American professional basketball player. He played collegiately for the [[University of Utah]]. 

== High school and college career ==
Kuzma attended [[Bentley High School]] in Michigan before enrolling at the [[University of Utah]] in 2014. His college career featured double-digit scoring averages as a sophomore and junior, pouring in 16.4 points per game in his final year with the Utes, while pulling down 9.3 rebounds and handing out 2.4 assists a contest. For his efforts, he was recognized with 2017 All-[[Pac-12 Conference men's basketball|Pac-12]] First Team honors.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.utahutes.com/news/2017/3/6/mens-basketball-kuzma-named-to-all-pac-12-first-team.aspx|title=Kuzma Named to All-Pac-12 First Team|access-date=2017-05-26|language=en}}</ref>

After the conclusion of the 2016-17 campaign, Kuzma announced to forgo his senior year to enter the [[2017 NBA draft]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.standard.net/Utah-Utes/2017/05/03/Utah-basketball-Kyle-Kuzma-hire-agent-remain-in-NBA-Draft|title=Utah basketball's Kyle Kuzma to hire agent, remain in NBA Draft|last=Standard-Examiner|work=Standard-Examiner|access-date=2017-05-26}}</ref>
